scope: infrastructure fixture only; no B3, B4, learning, or mechanism claim

selection.rounding: floor to committed tick; reject colliding or endpoint indices
selection.include: all declared run IDs and all three phases, regardless of activity or outcome

panel.intervention: replace all selected plastic weights with the same initial policy; start both arms from fresh zero state with teaching and updates disabled
panel.saturated_if: any selected weight is at its configured upper or lower bound
panel.failed_if: checkpoint, replay, frozen reset, panel execution or invariant check raises

gates.A5.1: deterministic complete unique selections for any valid predeclared horizon and run set; invalid horizons rejected
gates.A5.2: every selected fixture state saved with identity and reason, then exact restored continuation to the fixture horizon
gates.A5.3: same frozen panel and declared intervention run or explicit failure row for every selected state; no omitted silent or saturated states
